card.name: Linking word before risk comparison figures
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a risk or incidence figure (e.g. relative risk, incidence rate) before the outcome, and "patients" after a treated-group label. Also "billion" after a number in a statistic.

modes.label: Risk of outcome
modes.description: "of" following a relative risk or incidence rate, just before the named outcome such as suicidal thinking.
modes.example: s had approximately twice the risk (adjusted Relative Risk 1.8, 95% CI:1.2, 2.7)<< of>> suicidal thinking or behavior compared to patients randomized

modes.label: Treated patients
modes.description: "patients" after a drug-treated label with a percentage, in trial results comparing to placebo.
modes.example: infections (roundworm, hookworm, whipworm, threadworm), 53% (36/68) of XOLAIR-treated<< patients>> experienced an infection, as diagnosed by standard

modes.label: Large count
modes.description: "billion" after a number in a statistic about a share of a total.
modes.example: annually, Collins said, 215 billion drink containers are sold, of which 141<< billion>> are wasted. Americans consume 72

card.writes: It weakly pushes against words like half and third, so the text continues with a specific outcome rather than a fraction.
card.plain: It fires on small words in trial statistics that sit between a number and what the number describes.
